-- DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ff_csv
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ff_csv
WITH (  
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS ( FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',', STRING_DELIMITER = '"', FIRST_ROW = 2   )
);
-- GO

-- GO

-- GO
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE salesExternalTable;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE salesExternalTable
(
    [sale_id]   VARCHAR(50),
    [product]   VARCHAR(100),
    [category]  VARCHAR(50),
    [quantity]  INT,
    [price]     DECIMAL(18,2),
    [sale_date] DATE,
    [region]    VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'synapse-file/clintrail_data_files/TA/TA.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = ds_stsyn_file_data,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_csv
);


select * from dbo.salesExternalTable
select * from dbo.salesExternalTable where product='Laptop'
select quantity from dbo.salesExternalTable
